Sandbox_FirearmCursor_ShowTargetMarker_t: Draws the green / orange / red marker at the square the game is aiming at while a firearm is aimed. Turn off to keep only the normal isometric cursor.
Sandbox_FirearmCursor_DisableVanillaHitC: Hides the valid-target reticle the game colours while aiming. Off leaves the vanilla indicator exactly as the game draws it.
Sandbox_FirearmCursor_DisableFirearmUseD: Forces the vanilla sandbox setting FirearmUseDamageChance to Disabled (1) for the session. Off leaves your value alone.
